opportunities.summary_en: A national matching portal for job vacancies, training opportunities and career guidance.
opportunities.summary_rw: Urubuga ruhuza abashaka akazi n'akazi, amahugurwa n'ubujyanama ku mwuga.
eligibility_en: Individual listings set their own education, skills and experience requirements.
A profile and contact channel may be required to apply.
eligibility_rw: Buri kazi kagira amashuri, ubumenyi n'uburambe gasaba.
Konti n'uburyo bwo kuvugana bishobora gusabwa mu gusaba akazi.
opportunities.availability_en: Dynamic portal: confirm each listing's status and closing date before applying.
opportunities.availability_rw: Amatangazo arahinduka: banza urebe ko itangazo rigifunguye n'itariki rirangiriraho.
next_steps_en: Create a truthful profile using the applicant's own official details.
Filter current listings by skill and location.
Check every requirement and closing date before submitting.
next_steps_rw: Fungura konti ukoresheje amakuru nyayo y'usaba.
Shakisha amatangazo ajyanye n'ubumenyi n'aho atuye.
Reba ibisabwa byose n'itariki ntarengwa mbere yo kohereza ubusabe.

opportunities.summary_en: Connects eligible students and graduates to professional internship opportunities in industry.
opportunities.summary_rw: Ruhuza abanyeshuri n'abaharangije bujuje ibisabwa n'aho kwimenyereza umwuga.
eligibility_en: Designed for applicants seeking professional internship placement.
Each placement may require a specific qualification or graduation status.
eligibility_rw: Buri mwanya ushobora gusaba amashuri cyangwa icyiciro runaka.
opportunities.availability_en: Dynamic portal: internship calls and deadlines change throughout the year.
opportunities.availability_rw: Amatangazo n'amatariki yo gusaba birahinduka mu mwaka.
next_steps_en: Confirm the applicant's graduation or study status.
Prepare education records and a CV outside Inzira AI.
Review current calls and apply only through the official portal.
next_steps_rw: Emeza icyiciro cy'amashuri cyangwa igihe yarangirije.
Tegura ibyangombwa by'amashuri na CV hanze ya Inzira AI.
Reba amatangazo ahari kandi usabe unyuze ku rubuga rwemewe gusa.

opportunities.title_en: RTB career, internship and job matching
opportunities.title_rw: RTB: guhuza ubumenyi n'akazi cyangwa kwimenyereza umwuga
opportunities.summary_en: A free career platform connecting TVET students and graduates with companies, internships and jobs.
opportunities.summary_rw: Urubuga rw'ubuntu ruhuza abanyeshuri n'abarangije TVET n'ibigo, kwimenyereza umwuga n'akazi.
eligibility_en: Primarily intended for TVET students and graduates.
Companies set the requirements for each opportunity.
eligibility_rw: Yibanda cyane ku banyeshuri n'abarangije TVET.
Ibigo ni byo bishyiraho ibisabwa kuri buri mwanya.
opportunities.availability_en: Dynamic portal: company offers and internships can open or close at any time.
opportunities.availability_rw: Amatangazo y'ibigo ashobora gufungurwa cyangwa gufungwa igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
next_steps_en: Create a TVET career profile.
Add verified skills, qualifications and portfolio evidence.
Apply to a suitable current company offer.
next_steps_rw: Fungura konti kuri RTB Career Portal.
Shyiramo ubumenyi, impamyabushobozi n'ibikorwa byemejwe.
Saba itangazo ry'ikigo rijyanye n'ubumenyi bwawe.

opportunities.summary_en: Assesses skills needs and routes people toward registered short vocational training opportunities.
opportunities.summary_rw: Isuzuma ubumenyi bukenewe kandi igafasha kwiyandikisha mu mahugurwa y'imyuga y'igihe gito.
eligibility_en: Course availability and admission requirements depend on the current provider and call.
Confirm that the provider and course are recognised by RTB before paying.
eligibility_rw: Amahugurwa n'ibisabwa biterwa n'ikigo n'itangazo bihari.
Banza wemeze ko ikigo n'amahugurwa byemewe na RTB mbere yo kwishyura.
opportunities.availability_en: Pathway verified; specific short-course enrolment windows vary by district and provider.
opportunities.availability_rw: Inzira yemejwe; igihe cyo kwiyandikisha giterwa n'akarere n'ikigo gitanga amahugurwa.
next_steps_en: Choose the occupation the participant wants to learn.
Ask RTB or a recognised local TVET provider about current short courses.
Confirm accreditation, total fees, schedule and certificate before enrolling.
next_steps_rw: Hitamo umwuga umuntu ashaka kwiga.
Baza RTB cyangwa ishuri rya TVET ryemewe ku mahugurwa ahari.
Emeza ko yemewe, amafaranga yose, igihe n'impamyabushobozi mbere yo kwiyandikisha.

opportunities.provider: Rwanda Agriculture and Animal Resources Development Board
opportunities.title_rw: Ubujyanama mu buhinzi bwa Twigire Muhinzi
opportunities.summary_en: Local extension through Farmer Promoters, FFS facilitators and Sector Agronomists for agricultural practices and technology transfer.
opportunities.summary_rw: Ubujyanama bwo hafi butangwa n'Abafashamyumvire, abayobozi ba FFS n'Abagoronome b'Imirenge.
eligibility_en: The household should be engaged in or preparing for a relevant crop or livestock activity.
Specific input, livestock and cooperative programmes have separate criteria.
eligibility_rw: Urugo rugomba kuba rukora cyangwa ruteganya igikorwa cy'ubuhinzi cyangwa ubworozi.
Gahunda z'inyongeramusaruro, amatungo na koperative zigira ibisabwa byazo.
opportunities.availability_en: Extension pathway is nationwide; the exact service depends on season, location and activity.
opportunities.availability_rw: Ubujyanama buri mu gihugu hose; serivisi nyayo iterwa n'igihembwe, aho umuntu atuye n'igikorwa.
next_steps_en: Identify the main crop, livestock activity or production problem.
Contact the local Farmer Promoter, FFS facilitator or Sector Agronomist.
Request a specific technical or cooperative-market referral and agree a follow-up date.
next_steps_rw: Menya igihingwa, ubworozi cyangwa ikibazo cy'umusaruro cy'ingenzi.
Vugana n'Umufashamyumvire, umuyobozi wa FFS cyangwa Agronome w'Umurenge.
Saba ubujyanama bwihariye cyangwa koperative, mwumvikane itariki yo gukurikirana.

opportunities.title_rw: Isuzuma rya VUP ku iterambere ry'imibereho
opportunities.summary_en: An official local assessment route for applicable skills development, productive assets and other economic-inclusion services.
opportunities.summary_rw: Inzira y'isuzuma ryemewe ku mahugurwa, ibikoresho bitanga umusaruro n'izindi serivisi z'iterambere.
eligibility_en: Matching does not establish VUP or economic-inclusion eligibility.
A Cell/Sector officer and the official social registry must complete the assessment.
eligibility_rw: Guhuzwa n'iyi gahunda ntibyemeza ko wemerewe VUP cyangwa izindi serivisi.
Umukozi w'Akagari/Umurenge n'ububiko bwemewe ni bo bakora isuzuma rya nyuma.
opportunities.availability_en: Current national pathway; the exact service and enrolment depend on official local assessment and programme capacity.
opportunities.availability_rw: Ni inzira ikoreshwa ubu; serivisi no kwinjira muri gahunda biterwa n'isuzuma ryemewe n'ubushobozi bwa gahunda.
next_steps_en: Visit the Cell or Sector office and ask for the SEDO, Social Affairs Officer or para-social worker.
Request an economic-inclusion and household-needs assessment.
Record the required verification, responsible officer and follow-up date.
next_steps_rw: Jya ku Kagari cyangwa Umurenge ubaze SEDO, ushinzwe imibereho myiza cyangwa para-social worker.
Saba isuzuma ry'iterambere n'ibikenewe mu rugo.
Andika ibikenewe kugenzurwa, umukozi ubishinzwe n'itariki yo gukurikirana.

opportunities.provider: RDB / District Employment and Business Development Services
opportunities.title_rw: Ubujyanama mu bucuruzi no kwitegura gushaka igishoro
opportunities.summary_en: Local business-development advice covering business planning, market access, mentoring and preparation for suitable finance providers.
opportunities.summary_rw: Ubujyanama bwo hafi ku igenamigambi, amasoko, gutozwa no kwitegura kwegera ibigo by'imari biboneye.
eligibility_en: This is an advisory and referral pathway, not a promise of a grant or loan.
Any finance provider performs its own viability, affordability and eligibility assessment.
eligibility_rw: Iyi ni inzira y'ubujyanama, si isezerano ry'inkunga cyangwa inguzanyo.
Ikigo cy'imari ni cyo gisuzuma umushinga, ubushobozi bwo kwishyura n'ibisabwa.
opportunities.availability_en: Advisory pathway verified; confirm the current officer, provider and product before applying or paying fees.
opportunities.availability_rw: Inzira y'ubujyanama yemejwe; banza wemeze umukozi, ikigo na serivisi biriho mbere yo gusaba cyangwa kwishyura.
next_steps_en: Write a one-page description of the idea, customer and expected costs.
Ask the Sector or District business-development service for mentoring and market validation.
Approach a suitable regulated finance provider only after reviewing repayment obligations and total cost.
next_steps_rw: Andika ku rupapuro rumwe igitekerezo, abakiriya n'amafaranga ateganyijwe.
Saba serivisi y'ubucuruzi ku Murenge cyangwa Akarere ubujyanama no kugenzura isoko.
Egera ikigo cy'imari cyemewe nyuma yo gusobanukirwa uko uzishyura n'igiciro cyose.
